name: Yuisaki Seri
source:
The bright leader with good manners and high social influence. He's the founder of Liar-S' predecessor, S-leeper. Because he can immediately open anyone's heart, he has many acquaintances in the industry. He's a fast-thinker who learns the ropes of everything easily.
